function displayPerkInfo() -- name: displayPerkInfo
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_10

			local v19 = v16.message or ""

				v_u_7.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
				v_u_7.Active = false
				v_u_11.Visible = false
			else
				v_u_7.Text = tostring(v18 or "?")
				v_u_7.AutoButtonColor = true
				v_u_7.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 46, 107)
				v_u_7.Active = true

		v_u_7.Active = false

	end
end

local v3 = v1.Position

	["Position"] = v4
})
local v_u_7 = v2:Create(v1, v5, {
	["Position"] = v3
})
local v_u_8 = false
v1.InputBegan:Connect(function(p9)
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_7
	if p9.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or p9.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		if v_u_8 then
			return
		end
		v_u_8 = true
		v_u_6:Play()
		task.delay(10, function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_8
			v_u_7:Play()
			v_u_8 = false

function displayPerkInfo() -- name: displayPerkInfo
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_10
	local v15 = v_u_9.Text
	if v15 and v15 ~= "" then
		local v16 = v_u_4:InvokeServer(v15)
		if type(v16) == "table" then
			local v17 = v16.level or 0
			local v18 = v16.price
			local v19 = v16.message or ""
			if v17 == 0 then
				v_u_7.Text = "Locked"
				v_u_7.AutoButtonColor = false
				v_u_7.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
				v_u_7.Active = false
				v_u_11.Visible = false
			elseif v17 >= 3 then
				v_u_7.Text = "Max Level"
				v_u_7.AutoButtonColor = false
				v_u_7.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
				v_u_7.Active = false
				v_u_11.Visible = false
			else
				v_u_7.Text = tostring(v18 or "?")
				v_u_7.AutoButtonColor = true
				v_u_7.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 46, 107)
				v_u_7.Active = true
				v_u_11.Visible = true
			end
			v_u_12.Visible = v17 >= 1
			v_u_13.Visible = v17 >= 2
			v_u_14.Visible = v17 >= 3
			if v_u_10 then
				v_u_10.Text = v19
			end
		else
			warn("Bad response from GetPerkInfo:", v16)
			v_u_7.Text = "Error"
			v_u_7.Active = false
		end
	else
		warn("No perk selected!")
		v_u_7.Text = "Error"
		v_u_7.Active = false
		return
	end
end

local function v_u_70(p49, p50) -- name: playCutscene
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_41, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_5
	if p49 and v_u_12:HasTag(v_u_41, "Ready") then
		game:GetService("UserInputService").MouseIconEnabled = true
		v_u_13.FieldOfView = 70
		game:GetService("SoundService"):WaitForChild("chase").Volume = 0
		v_u_41:SetAttribute("isspectating", true)
		if p50 then
			v_u_41:SetAttribute("killerend", true)
		elseif #v_u_23 > 0 then
			v_u_23[math.random(1, #v_u_23)]:Play()
		else
			warn("No sound instances found in the descendants!")
		end
		local v51 = v_u_41:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
		local v52 = {
			["Results"] = true,
			["EndScreen"] = true,
			["Darkness"] = true
		}
		for _, v53 in ipairs(v51:GetChildren()) do
			if v53:IsA("ScreenGui") then
				v53.Enabled = v52[v53.Name] or false
			end
		end
		local v54 = workspace:WaitForChild("BackgroundSounds")
		for _, v55 in ipairs(v54:GetChildren()) do
			v55:Destroy()
		end
		local v56 = p49:GetChildren()
		table.sort(v56, function(p57, p58)
			local v59 = p57.Name
			local v60 = tonumber(v59)
			local v61 = p58.Name
			local v62 = tonumber(v61)
			if v60 and v62 then
				return v60 < v62
			else
				return p57.Name < p58.Name
			end
		end)
		local v63 = v_u_4.CurrentCamera
		v63.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		for v64 = 1, #v56 do
			local v65 = v56[v64]
			local v66 = v65:GetAttribute("type")
			local v67 = v65:GetAttribute("time") or 1
			if v64 == 1 then
				v63.CFrame = v65.CFrame
			end
			if v66 == "end" then
				v63.CFrame = v65.CFrame
				return
			end
			if v64 < #v56 then
				local v68 = v56[v64 + 1]
				if v66 == "smooth" then
					wait(2)
					local v69 = v_u_5:Create(v63, TweenInfo.new(v67, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {
						["CFrame"] = v68.CFrame
					})
					v69:Play()
					v69.Completed:Wait()
				elseif v66 == "cut" then
					wait(v67)
					v63.CFrame = v68.CFrame
				else
					warn("Unrecognized camera Type \'" .. tostring(v66) .. "\' on camera: " .. v65.Name)
				end
			end
		end
	else
		warn("No cameras folder received for cutscene or not ready.")
	end
end
